answer_1.quote: We propose a novel T5-based lemmatization model that is (i) contextualized, so that relevant morphological indicators can be inferred by the model on the fly from the token's surrounding context. (ii) The model works end-to-end: it receives the surface form of the word to be lemmatized in its full sentence context and predicts its lemma without receiving or predicting PoS tags or morphological features.
answer_1.outputs: lemmas, dependency parses, POS tags, semantic predictions

answer_2.quote: For PoS tagging, UD provides universal PoS tags (UPoS) and language-specific PoS tags (XPoS)... we report the accuracy for both PoS tag sets. For dependency parsing, we report the unlabeled attachment score (UAS) and the labeled attachment score (LAS).
